featured.title: Durable Brief
featured.blurb: a one-page briefing desk on the Vercel Workflow SDK: parallel research, sequential draft, evaluator-optimizer loop, then a human approval hook. Close the tab or redeploy — the run is still waiting; publish has not happened.

featured.title: PulseQueue
featured.blurb: watch a job queue work in real time: workers lease jobs, retries use exponential backoff, and poison messages land in a dead-letter queue. Pure TypeScript queue engine (no HTTP in the core, so lease exclusivity and DLQ rules are unit-tested) with a React dashboard over Server-Sent Events.

featured.title: SketchSync
featured.blurb: realtime collaborative whiteboard: shareable rooms, live named cursors, per-user undo, and PNG export. Raw WebSockets (no Socket.IO) over a typed message protocol; Node.js + Express server with unit-tested room logic, React canvas frontend.

featured.title: ResuMatch
featured.blurb: paste a resume and a job description, get a 0–100 match score, skill-gap breakdown, and concrete suggestions. Deterministic TF-IDF + skill-extraction core with an optional LLM coaching layer; React 19 + TypeScript frontend, FastAPI backend, tested and CI-checked.
